purpose: Metadata draft for root review of FNO and MLP routes; no final-data selection or release.

geometry_encoder.coordinates: Prepared canonical xyz only; no role channels, targets or case ID

input_schema.hash: xyz3 encoded by native Hash12; original25+global32 identity condition_dim57
input_schema.FNO_global_broadcast: Append32 to every cube voxel, including occupancy0 voxels

output_schema.scaling: Encoded signed fields; trainer owns common train-only scaler/decode
output_schema.activation: Unrestricted output; no abs, clipping or stress replacement

backbone.input_schema: occupancy1 + canonical xyz3 + BC/material25 + shared global32

expected_model_source_config.precision: PointNet/torch solvers float32 inputs; Hash native FP16 compute/FP32 master/float32 output; trainer owns autocast/TF32 policy
expected_model_source_config.context_lifetime: Recompute encoder each optimizer update; reuse same live context across point chunks and accumulate its gradients
expected_model_source_config.distributed_cleanup: Trainer finally calls close_selection_process_group; closes only adapter-owned ++ group

budget_semantics.budget: Whole cumulative confirmation endpoint training budget, including warm parent and pass overshoot; selection cost for each method/seed.
budget_semantics.selected_checkpoint_costs: Costs observed at the selected endpoint or VAL-best checkpoint; not the total route-selection budget.
budget_semantics.secondary_budget_origin: Exact original summary.best_checkpoint_origin, including any historical screen origin.

selection_basis: Development-validation summaries and measured confirmation costs only; root may change the proposal before formally freezing final routes.

scope_receipt.checkpoint_identity: Path and bytes/mtime_ns stat only; no weight-file hashing or tensor comparison.
